svg.title: Weight regain after stopping Wegovy or Zepbound in three randomized trials
svg.desc: Percent of starting weight lost. STEP 1 extension: 17.3% on semaglutide at week 68, 5.6% one year after stopping, about two-thirds regained. STEP 4: 10.6% after 20 weeks on semaglutide, 5.0% after 48 weeks on placebo, about half regained. SURMOUNT-4: 20.9% after 36 weeks on tirzepatide, 9.9% after 52 weeks on placebo, about half regained.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop the shot, and about half to two-thirds comes back in a year
